identity_prompt: A friendly college student in his early twenties, short dark hair, light stubble, wearing a grey hoodie over a t-shirt, a backpack on one shoulder, expressive and enthusiastic.
style: Photorealistic live-action cinema, 35mm film grain, natural lens, 24fps, modern tech-vlog aesthetic, crisp and clean. No cartoon, no subtitles, no watermark.
lighting: bright clean retail and modern-home lighting, cool white highlights with warm accents, shallow depth of field
tone: upbeat, aspirational, exciting, energetic maker story
audio_bed: light upbeat electronic background music, soft room tone

keyframes.prompt: the student stands in a bright electronics superstore aisle (Microcenter-style), shelves of computer hardware and glowing boxes behind him, looking around excited
the student in the store aisle lifts a small compact NVIDIA DGX Spark desktop AI computer box off the shelf, eyes wide with excitement, reading the box
the student at the store checkout counter, two identical small NVIDIA DGX Spark boxes and a thick ConnectX-7 network cable on the counter, tapping his card to pay
the student walking out through the store's glass doors into a sunny parking lot, carrying a shopping bag with the two boxes, grinning
the student at a tidy home desk, unboxing two small NVIDIA DGX Spark computers side by side, packing foam around, monitor glowing behind
close on two small NVIDIA DGX Spark computers side by side on the desk, a thick ConnectX-7 cable plugged between their ports, status LEDs glowing green
the student at the desk, a large monitor showing a dark terminal booting a dual-serve AI stack with glowing green text and two model status panels lighting up
the monitor shows a split screen: an AI chat agent on the left and two AI video-generation previews rendering side by side on the right, the student leaning in amazed, face lit by the screen

the student holding up his phone showing a social media (X-style) post of his AI-generated videos, floating like and reward notification badges popping around it, a big proud smile, glowing desk setup behind

spans.motion: slow push-in as the student scans the shelves and steps forward reaching toward the hardware
spans.audio: store ambience, faint beeps, upbeat music swelling
spans.say: I walked into Microcenter looking for serious AI horsepower.

spans.motion: he lifts the DGX Spark box and turns it in his hands, reading it, nodding
spans.audio: soft box handling, an excited breath
spans.say: The dee-gee-ex Spark. A desktop AI supercomputer.

spans.motion: he sets two boxes and the cable on the counter and taps his card, a confirmation beep
spans.audio: counter chatter, card terminal beep, register chime
spans.say: So I grabbed two, plus a CX seven cable to link them.

spans.motion: he pushes through the glass doors into sunlight, bag in hand, walking toward camera
spans.audio: door chime, footsteps, outdoor air, music lifting
spans.say: Two dee-gee-ex Sparks. Time to build.

spans.motion: at the desk he lifts the two Sparks from the box and sets them side by side
spans.say: Got them both set up on my desk.

spans.motion: hands plug the ConnectX-7 cable between the two units; the LEDs blink to steady green
spans.audio: a soft click, a quiet electronic power-up tone
spans.say: Linked with the cable for true dual Spark serving.

spans.motion: he hits enter and the terminal boots, green text scrolling, two panels lighting up
spans.audio: keyboard clack, a rising boot chime
spans.say: Loaded the Keys Unleashed dual serve stack.

spans.motion: the split screen comes alive with a chat agent and two video previews rendering in parallel while he watches, then he raises his phone showing the posted video with reward badges popping
spans.audio: soft UI chimes, notification pops, triumphant upbeat music
spans.say: DeepSeek and two MiniMax H3s in parallel. I'm an X creator now.
